      function setImportant(el, prop, value) {
        if (!el || !el.style) return;
        el.style.setProperty(prop, value, 'important');
      }

      function forceElementorParents(page) {
        if (!page) return;
        var node = page.parentElement;
        var limit = 0;

        while (node && node !== document.body && limit < 8) {
          var cls = node.className ? String(node.className) : '';

          if (
            cls.indexOf('elementor') !== -1 ||
            cls.indexOf('wp-block') !== -1 ||
            cls.indexOf('entry-content') !== -1 ||
            cls.indexOf('site-content') !== -1 ||
            cls.indexOf('content-area') !== -1
          ) {
            setImportant(node, 'max-width', 'none');
            setImportant(node, 'width', '100%');
            setImportant(node, 'padding-left', '0');
            setImportant(node, 'padding-right', '0');
            setImportant(node, 'margin-left', '0');
            setImportant(node, 'margin-right', '0');
            setImportant(node, 'overflow', 'visible');
          }

          node = node.parentElement;
          limit++;
        }
      }

      function forceFullWidth() {
        var page = document.querySelector(pageSelector);
        if (!page) return;

        forceElementorParents(page);

        if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
          setImportant(page, 'left', 'auto');
          setImportant(page, 'width', '100%');

          setImportant(page, 'margin-right', '0');

        setImportant(page, 'overflow-x', 'hidden');
        setImportant(page, 'transform', 'none');
